architecture.sharedBounds: The two identical, capture-free bboxOf functions now share vegetation-polygons.js.
architecture.imports: New modules use direct relative URLs to the already bundled libraries. All 27 alias replacements resolve to exactly the original import-map URLs; no packages or rule configuration were added.
architecture.renderTarget: Two lookups of unavailable THREE.WebGPURenderTarget now directly use THREE.RenderTarget, the constructor selected by the original fallback with the shipped bundle. The differential harness verifies the missing export.

astEquivalence.method: Restore explicit state-property references to their original lexical bindings and expand the 12 phase helper calls back into their unchanged statements; then compare complete token sequences. Normalize only the verified shared bboxOf declarations and unavailable render-target fallback. Initial relocation also matched all functions before phase extraction.

differentialValidation.method: Load baseline and refactored code in separate VM realms with the actual bundled Three.js. Compare exact geometry and instance-buffer hashes using seeded random inputs. Compare resource-disposal traces and reset state. Replace only asset loaders with controlled success/failure fixtures to exercise their asynchronous contracts.
additionalAssertions: Grass eviction retains the same mesh and typed-array storage while removing the old cache entry.
Pooled tree visibility uses meshes nearby, populated billboards farther away, and neither beyond render range.
Concurrent tree asset requests share the same promise; later calls retain the prior success or failure behavior.
testOnlyAdjustments: The optional pooled-tree case sets TREE_STATIC_MODE to false in both in-memory subjects; production retains true.
Exception messages and loader order are compared while expected relocated-file stack-frame lines are excluded.

combinedBrowserTests.skipReason: Cmd hotkey case is not applicable on Windows.

integration.gpuValidation: The real GPU lifecycle test m73-map-3d-controls passed in 48.3 seconds with two actual WebGPU entry/exit cycles, a visible stage, and correct pointer-lock and control transitions.
integration.builds: Desktop and mobile web builds passed.
